name: The Apartment
summary: A new apartment. A polite neighbor who knows every package you get. He wants his share, a little more every day. Keep him fed or become the meal. The Apartment is a single-location, first-person psychological horror built on observation, tension and repetition. Shop for limited resources, guess what he wants and be ready when he knocks. When the alarm goes off, finish his tasks before the timer runs out. Every room hides secrets: solve puzzles, decode clues and piece together what is really going on, all in an analog horror VHS look. Multiple endings, and not all of them let you survive.
